arxiv-1910-04935.title: FetusMap: Fetal Pose Estimation in 3D Ultrasound
arxiv-1910-04935.creator: Xin Yang 1, Wenlong Shi 2,3, Haoran Dou 2,3, Jikuan Qian 2,3, Yi Wang 2,3, Wufeng Xue 2,3, Shengli Li 4, Dong Ni 2,3∗, Pheng-Ann Heng 1
arxiv-1910-04935.description: Abstract The 3D ultrasound (US) entrance inspires a multitude of automated prenatal examinations. However, studies about the structuralized description of the whole fetus in 3D US are still rare. In this paper, we propose to estimate the 3D pose of fetus in US volumes to facilitate its quantitative analyses in global and local scales.

arxiv-2010-04690.title: Robust Isometric Non-Rigid Structure-from-Motion
arxiv-2010-04690.creator: Shaifali Parashar, Daniel Pizarro, Adrien Bartoli
arxiv-2010-04690.description: Abstract Non-Rigid Structure-from-Motion (NRSfM) reconstructs a deformable 3D object from keypoint correspondences established between monocular 2D images. Current NRSfM methods lack statistical robustness, which is the ability to cope with correspondence errors. This prevents one to use automatically established correspondences, which are prone to errors, thereby strongly limiting the scope of NRSfM.

arxiv-2101-09575.title: Examining Factors Associated with Twitter Account Suspension Following the 2020 U.S. Presidential Election
arxiv-2101-09575.creator: Farhan Asif Chowdhury, Dheeman Saha, Md Rashidul Hasan, Koustuv Saha, Abdullah Mueen
arxiv-2101-09575.description: Abstract Online social media enables mass-level, transparent, and democratized discussion on numerous socio-political issues. Due to such openness, these platforms often endure manipulation and misinformation - leading to negative impacts. To prevent such harmful activities, platform moderators employ countermeasures to safeguard against actors violating their rules.

arxiv-2103-13053.title: Sequence of Events During Peptide Unbinding from RNase S: A Complete Experimental Description
arxiv-2103-13053.creator: Brankica Jankovic, Jeannette Ruf, Claudio Zanobini, Olga Bozovic, David Buhrke, Peter Hamm ∗
arxiv-2103-13053.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Brankica Jankovic, Jeannette Ruf, Claudio Zanobini, Olga Bozovic, David Buhrke, Peter Hamm ∗. Abstract : The photo-triggered unbinding of the intrinsically disordered S-peptide from the RNase S complex is studied with the help of transient IR spectroscopy, covering a wide range of time scales from 100 ps to 10 ms. To that end, an azobenzene moiety has been linked to the S-peptide in a way that its helicity is disrupted by light, thereby initiating its complete unbinding.

arxiv-2211-06440.title: Data Quality Over Quantity: Pitfalls and Guidelines for Process Analytics
arxiv-2211-06440.creator: Lim C. Siang, Shams Elnawawi, Lee D. Rippon, Daniel L. O’Connor, R. Bhushan Gopaluni
arxiv-2211-06440.description: Abstract A significant portion of the effort involved in advanced process control, process analytics, and machine learning involves acquiring and preparing data. Literature often emphasizes increasingly complex modelling techniques with incremental performance improvements. However, when industrial case studies are published they often lack important details on data acquisition and preparation.

arxiv-2212-10602.title: Page time and the order parameter for a consciousness state
arxiv-2212-10602.creator: Alexander Gorsky
arxiv-2212-10602.description: Abstract Abstract In this Letter using the analogy with the recent resolution of the black hole information paradox we conjecture the order parameter for the state of consciousness based on the notion of the Page curve and the Page time.

arxiv-2402-02385.title: A Survey on Robotics with Foundation Models: toward Embodied AI Thanks: ˜Equal contributions Thanks: ˜Corresponding author
arxiv-2402-02385.creator: Zhiyuan Xu, Kun WuJunjie WenJinming LiNing LiuZhengping Che, Jian Tang
arxiv-2402-02385.description: Abstract While the exploration for embodied AI has spanned multiple decades, it remains a persistent challenge to endow agents with human-level intelligence, including perception, learning, reasoning, decision-making, control, and generalization capabilities, so that they can perform general-purpose tasks in open, unstructured, and dynamic environments.

arxiv-2402-06802.title: Capturing the slow relaxation time of superparamagnetic colloids in time-varying fields
arxiv-2402-06802.creator: Lucas H. P. Cunha, Aldo Spatafora-Salazar, Dana M. Lobmeyer, Kedar Joshi, Fred C. MacKintosh, Sibani Lisa Biswal
arxiv-2402-06802.description: Abstract Superparamagnetic colloids present interesting assembly dynamics and propulsion in time-varying magnetic fields due to their magnetic relaxation. However, little is known about the mechanisms governing this magnetic relaxation, which is commonly attributed to the interactions and polydispersity of the ferromagnetic nanoparticles distributed within the colloid.

arxiv-2407-09473.title: StyleSplat: 3D Object Style Transfer with Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2407-09473.creator: Sahil Jain, Avik Kuthiala ⋆, Prabhdeep Singh Sethi, Prakanshul Saxena
arxiv-2407-09473.description: Abstract Recent advancements in radiance fields have opened new avenues for creating high-quality 3D assets and scenes. Style transfer can enhance these 3D assets with diverse artistic styles, transforming creative expression. However, existing techniques are often slow or unable to localize style transfer to specific objects.

arxiv-2504-17708.title: Pushing the frontiers of subexponential FPT time for Feedback Vertex Set
arxiv-2504-17708.creator: Gaétan Berthe, Marin Bougeret, Daniel Gonçalves, Jean-Florent Raymond
arxiv-2504-17708.description: Abstract . The paper deals with the Feedback Vertex Set problem parameterized by the solution size. Given a graph G G and a parameter k k , one has to decide if there is a set S S of at most k k vertices such that G − S G-S is acyclic.

britannica-1911-lothian-earls-and-marque.title: Lothian, Earls and Marquesses of (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-lothian-earls-and-marque.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lothian-earls-and-marque.description: Article 'Lothian, Earls and Marquesses of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. 1st earl of Lothian (d. 1609), was the eldest son of Mark Kerr (d. 1584), abbot, and then commendator, of Newbattle, or Newbottle, and was a member of the famous border family of Ker of Cessford.

europmc-pmc5759372.title: TerraClimate, a high-resolution global dataset of monthly climate and climatic water balance from 1958-2015.
europmc-pmc5759372.creator: Abatzoglou JT, Dobrowski SZ, Parks SA, Hegewisch KC.
europmc-pmc5759372.description: We present TerraClimate, a dataset of high-spatial resolution (1/24°, ~4-km) monthly climate and climatic water balance for global terrestrial surfaces from 1958-2015. TerraClimate uses climatically aided interpolation, combining high-spatial resolution climatological normals...

europmc-pmc6190891.title: Update on Neutrophil Function in Severe Inflammation.
europmc-pmc6190891.creator: Mortaz E, Alipoor SD, Adcock IM, Mumby S, Koenderman L.
europmc-pmc6190891.description: Neutrophils are main players in the effector phase of the host defense against micro-organisms and have a major role in the innate immune response. Neutrophils show phenotypic heterogeneity and functional flexibility, which highlight their importance in regulation of immune...

pmc-11318300.title: Optimizing resident training in obstetrics and gynecology: a new perspective on the refined Peyton four-step teaching method
pmc-11318300.creator: Dandan Zhang, Xiaoxue Wang, Xueting Chen, Yingze Lou, Xin Zhou, Kai Zhang
pmc-11318300.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveIn the surgery-focused field of obstetrics and gynecology (OB-GYN), the development of residents’ skills is paramount. This study aims to evaluate the impact of an enhanced Peyton Four-Step Teaching Model on the foundational skill training of first-year OB-GYN residents.MethodsUtilizing a cohort study design, we assessed 116 first-year residents from the OB-GYN residency program at Shengjing Hospital of China Medical University from June 2021 to June 2023.

pmc-11539394.title: Clinical outcomes of modified transarterial chemoembolization vs. drug-eluting bead transarterial chemoembolization as initial treatment for single hepatocellular carcinoma: a propensity score matching analysis
pmc-11539394.creator: Boyang Chang, Churen Zhou, Chengcheng Liu, Luwen Mu, Mingsheng Huang, Mingjun Bai
pmc-11539394.description: Background & aimsOptimizing transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) can enhance treatment efficacy for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This study compares modified TACE (M-TACE), which combines a lipiodol-based emulsion and drug-eluting beads, with drug-eluting bead TACE (DEB-TACE) as initial therapies for solitary HCC.MethodsIn this retrospective study, 185 patients undergoing M-TACE or DEB-TACE were evaluated. Propensity score matching was used to create 69 balanced pairs.

pmc-12467014.title: Development of a Multiplex Lateral Flow Immunoassay for the Detection of Antibiotics in Milk Utilizing Lyophilized Gold Nanoparticle Conjugates
pmc-12467014.creator: Ivan V. Maksin, Azhar Kuandykova, Darya I. Polyakova, Viktoriia A. Kesareva, Timofei A. Luzyanin, Vladislav S. Ivanov, Evgeniia I. Simonova, German A. Khunteev, Yuliya G. Kirillova
pmc-12467014.description: Lateral flow immunoassays (LFAs) are widely recognized as a powerful and versatile analytical platform. Nevertheless, the development of multiplex formats remains a distinct challenge. The aim of this study was to develop a multiplex LFA using gold nanoparticles (GNPs) as a label, selected for their ease of synthesis and functionalization with biomolecules.

pmc-12636384.title: Comprehensive serum glycopeptide spectrum analysis with machine learning for non-invasive early detection of gastrointestinal cancers
pmc-12636384.creator: Yuichi Hisamatsu, Kazuhiro Tanabe, Kensuke Kudo, Hirofumi Hasuda, Eiji Kusumoto, Hideo Uehara, Rintaro Yoshida, Mitsuhiko Ota, Yoshihisa Sakaguchi, Chihiro Hayashi, Mikio Mikami, Tetsuya Kusumoto
pmc-12636384.description: PurposeGastrointestinal cancers, including colorectal cancer (CRC), gastric cancer (GC), and esophageal cancer (EC), are among the most common and lethal malignancies worldwide. Early detection is critical for improving patient outcomes, but the current diagnostic methods, such as endoscopy, are burdensome, costly, and inaccessible for widespread screening.

pmc-12715191.title: Seasonal and cultural effects on calendar day variations in trauma incidence in Japan
pmc-12715191.creator: Keisuke Suzuki, Akira Endo, Tomohiro Akutsu, Hiromasa Hoshi, Akira Suekane, Ryo Yamamoto, Kazuma Yamakawa, Shin Watanabe, Akihiro Hirakawa, Yasuhiro Otomo, Koji Morishita
pmc-12715191.description: Trauma incidence patterns are influenced by societal and cultural factors. However, research has mainly focused on short-term periods. This study examined daily trauma trends throughout the year to identify fluctuations aligned with lifestyle patterns under a relatively homogeneous ethnocultural context, using long-term nationwide trauma data.

pmc-12748746.title: Powering and mobility through disasters: a dial-a-ride problem for electric taxis with charging and discharging regulations
pmc-12748746.creator: Hamid R Sayarshad
pmc-12748746.description: This study proposes an integrated strategy to effectively utilize electric taxis (ETs) for post-event recovery of power distribution networks (DNs) in disaster scenarios. The approach addresses a dial-a-ride problem (DARP) by coordinating charging and discharging regulations to improve grid security. It focuses on optimal taxi routes, considering charging, and limited range.

pmc-13302716.title: Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus and Dense Spontaneous Echo Contrast in Anticoagulated Atrial Fibrillation Patients Referred for Cardioversion: Beyond CHA2DS2-VASc and Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices
pmc-13302716.creator: Kinga Gościńska-Bis, Michał Pieczara, Jolanta Pol-Romik, Jolanta Biernat, Magdalena Cybulska, Kamil Kempa, Eugeniusz Piłat, Tomasz Roleder, Krzysztof S. Gołba

pmc-13463961.title: Cyanoacrylate glue as an effective skin-decontamination method for hair follicle microbiome sampling: insights from a nonhuman model (Capreolus capreolus)
pmc-13463961.creator: Dita Gudra, Megija Lunge, Edmunds Skinderskis, Ance Roga, Silvestrs Rubins, Davids Fridmanis
pmc-13463961.description: IntroductionIn humans, microorganisms within hair follicles differ from those on the skin surface and may contribute to autoimmune skin diseases such as alopecia areata and vitiligo. Owing to the low biomass of hair follicle microorganisms, precise sample acquisition and strategies to avoid contamination with genetic material are critical.

pmc-13511606.title: Enolase-1 and Inflammation
pmc-13511606.creator: Rafael Fernandez, Asha Jacob, Monowar Aziz, Ping Wang
pmc-13511606.description: Enolase-1 (ENO-1) is classically known as a highly conserved glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of 2-phosphoglycerate to phosphoenolpyruvate in the final steps of glycolysis. This enzyme, however, is being increasingly implicated as a multifunctional moonlighting protein with compartment-specific roles in inflammation.

uslaw-usc-t10-s909.title: 10 U.S.C. § 909 — Art. 109. Property other than military property of United States—Waste, spoilage, or destruction
uslaw-usc-t10-s909.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s909.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 47 (Uniform Code Of Military Justice); Subchapter X (Punitive Articles). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person subject to this chapter who willfully or recklessly wastes, spoils, or otherwise willfully and wrongfully destroys or damages any property other than military property of the United States shall be punished as a court-martial.
